evidence_notes: Peter, 27, male, diagnosed with Crohn's two years ago, possibly longer. Also has ADHD and anxiety. Symptoms initially attributed to ADHD meds and poor diet. Worsened after graduation. Treated with mesalamine suppositories/oral and prednisone (caused anxiety/panic attack). Started azathioprine six months ago with ~40% improvement. Doctor wants to try biologics but patient is terrified due to anxiety, needle phobia, and fear of getting sick/missing work. Parents unsupportive. Girlfriend left due to 'too much work'. Struggles with work requirements (site visits, portapotties). Considering leaving profession due to health. Therapy is slow. Worried about long-term prognosis.
